verdict.rationale: Claude Design documents pulling in a team's design system (via /design-sync or codebase import) and applying it automatically to every project, which covers the 'applied across designs' part. It also offers Claude-made sliders for tuning spacing and color. There is no evidence of first-party token or variable management, and the PenPot token flow is a different product reached via MCP, so it earns no credit. missing for 10: explicit design-token/variable editing (colors, spacing, typography), modes or themes support, documentation of how tokens propagate across designs, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a designer, I can manage design tokens or variables — colors, spacing, typography — with modes or themes applied across designs

citations.quote: Claude can also apply your team's design system to every project automatically, so the output is consistent with the rest of your company's designs.
Pull in your design system from Claude Code using /design-sync
use the adjustment sliders Claude creates to tune spacing and color.
